svg.data-latency: less than 700 ns port to port (cut-through)
svg.data-cpu: Intel Xeon D-1627 4-core or D-1649N 8-core on a COMe module (per SKU)
svg.data-bmc: BMC management option (DDR3, SPI flash dual boot, NC-SI shared port, IPMI 2.0)
svg.data-breakout: 144 sub-rate ports maximum (10/25/50GbE) or 128 at 40/100GbE using breakout cables
svg.data-timing: IEEE 1588 1-step and 2-step, TC and BC, SyncE (timing option)
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: 10GBASE-CR/SR/LR/ER, 25GBASE-CR/SR/LR/ER, 40GBASE-CR4/SR4/LR4/ER4, 100GBASE-CR4/SR4/LR4/ER4/DR1/PSM4/CWDM4, 400GBASE-CR4/SR4/FR4/DR4/LR8 (guide Port Descriptions); DAC up to 3 m (datasheet)
svg.data-console: RJ45 RS-232, 115200 8N1, flow control XON/XOFF (labelled IOIOI)
svg.data-usb: USB 2.0 host type A, data only (does not supply power)

rect.data-members: fan-1 fan-2 fan-3 fan-4 fan-5 fan-6 fan-7
